description: This PHP script handles updating relationships between entities (likely database records) in the vtiger CRM system. It processes request parameters, determines the appropriate action, and calls functions to relate entities before redirecting to a detail or related list view.

classes.name: CRMEntity
classes.description: Represents a CRM entity with methods for instantiation and management.

methods.name: vtlib_purify
methods.description: Sanitizes input parameters to prevent security issues such as SQL injection.

methods.name: CRMEntity::getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of CRMEntity corresponding to a specified module.

methods.name: relateEntities
methods.description: Creates relationship links between source and destination entities within the CRM.
